errors.evidence: The pie chart is composed of five segments, not six as stated in the description.
The chart does not contain a category named „Тъмно гориво“ (Dark fuel). The description hallucinates this sixth category.
The slice representing „Твърди горива“ (Solid fuels) is blue, not „наситено червено“ (deep red).
The slice representing „Възобн. и биогорива“ (Renewable and biofuels) is purple, not „светло синьо“ (light blue).
The slice representing „Електрическа енергия“ (Electrical energy) is light blue, not „синьо“ (blue).
The slice representing „Течни горива“ (Liquid fuels) is red, not „зелено“ (green).
The slice representing „Природен газ“ (Natural gas) is green, not „светло зелено“ (light green).
